description: Owns reusable HarmonyOS application delivery practice and evaluation.

compatibility.statement: Compatible with Harness Kernel protocol 1.0. This Domain specializes reusable HarmonyOS application engineering practice without weakening Kernel authorization, security, privacy, evidence, approval, or lifecycle requirements; project and organization overlays must supply version, toolchain, device, permission, quality, signing, and release constraints that are not part of the public baseline.
